label.vi: Chữ to bật từng cụm 1-3 từ
label.en: Big pop-in, 1-3 words at a time

description: Very large outlined words, 1-3 at a time, each group pops in (scale bounce); the spoken word turns accent. High energy: vlog, hype, product.

keywords.doc: words that stay in the accent colour (product names, numbers, the CTA name)

top.doc: top edge as a fraction of frame height; keep it above the app's buttons and description (<= 0.75 on TikTok/Reels)

size.doc: font size as a fraction of frame width
